name: print-social-political-campaign-portrait-with-landmarks
title: Campaign poster with smiling candidate over sunset landmarks and yellow condensed type
whatItIs: A warm orange-to-red sunset backdrop with silhouettes of historic buildings and cacti. A smiling woman with long hair fills the left, a red name tag with a heart sits behind her shoulder, the slogan 'JUNTOS por Pernambuco e pelo Brasil' is set in tall yellow and white condensed caps, and a yellow outline map and green-yellow flag shape run along the bottom.
whatItMeans: Warm, local and optimistic; regional landmarks and national colours anchor identity.
techniques: Place a large friendly portrait against a warm sunset gradient.
Use tall condensed caps in yellow and white for the slogan.
Bring in local landmarks as tinted silhouettes.
Add a red name tag with a heart as a brand device.
Outline the region's map as a graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A small coloured label carrying a person's name.
A tinted outline of a local building used as backdrop.
A slogan in tall narrow letters.
A thin line drawing of a region.
